name: K-C Graniteville Distribution Center - Graniteville SC

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed at 1043 Global Ave, Graniteville SC, in Sage Mill Industrial Park. The DC is the 'Global Avenue Logistics Center' - a 450,033 sq ft Class-A cross-dock building on 30.1 acres, leased in full by Kimberly-Clark (CoStar reports K-C renewed its 450,000 sq ft lease). Roster ROOFTOP coords landed within the building footprint; locked center ~33.62405,-81.84755.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE - Street View (2024-03) of the truck-court entrance off Global Ave clearly shows a chain-link sliding gate across the truck lane plus a chain-link perimeter fence around the property (corroborated by leasing materials describing a 'fully secured site').
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE - a small peaked-roof guard booth sits immediately beside the truck lane at the gate, visible unmistakably in the close Street View frame. remoteGs therefore false.
fieldNotes.docks: Cross-dock building with dock doors and trailers backed in along BOTH long faces (NE and SW). Total well into the 50+ band; dockDoorCount ~120 is an honest overhead estimate for the two faces combined (loose).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: TRUE - cross-dock layout = two dock banks on opposite building faces, standard split shipping/receiving.
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE - marked trailer-parking lanes in the NE truck court hold trailers without tractors; dropArea estimated 25-50.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE - deep paved truck courts (leasing materials cite courts 'up to 185 ft deep') give 3+ trucks of stacking room inside the gate before the docks; drivewayLong true.
fieldNotes.entryExit: Single combined truck gate at the SE corner off Global Ave - entryExitTogether true; ~1 inbound + 1 outbound lane through the gate.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: FALSE - the gate is a single controlled lane group with no obvious unused paved width for a bypass.
fieldNotes.rail: FALSE active rail - the site is adjacent to a Norfolk Southern line and leasing materials note it COULD tie in via a rail spur, but no spur currently runs into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Sage Mill Industrial Park sits in woodland on the edge of small-town Graniteville SC, ~1.5 mi from I-20. Edge-of-town industrial - classified Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 30.1 acres is the documented parcel size; the axis-aligned perimeter box is a loose bounding box around a building elongated NW-SE and so overcounts the corners.
